result_text:
I changed `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so `all_files.zip` looks up and names its entries from the configured aspect names, the same way the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files are named.

**What was wrong:** the zip block hardcoded `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. When the aspect is renamed to `buildAndDeployment`, the file on disk is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, so the read threw `FileNotFoundException`. The surrounding `catch (Throwable t)` only printed the stack trace, which skipped both `all_files.zip` and `git-history.zip`.

**What changed:**
- The five `all_files.zip` entries now come from a new private helper, `getAspectFileListZipEntry(NamedSourceCodeAspect)`, placed just above `getTextDataFolder()`. The helper builds the name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is the same call used when the loose files are written. It returns the `{name, content}` pair for the zip.
- The entries are still in the order main, test, generated, build and deployment, other. With the default config the names are unchanged.

**Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl reports test` passes. There is no existing test for `DataExporter`, and I did not run an export with a renamed aspect. The rename case is therefore verified by reading the code, not by a run.

Nothing is committed.
